cohort: 675 consecutive singleton pregnancies with fetal normal growth and normal cardiac anatomy were enrolled.
finding: Fetal tricuspid regurgitation observed during the second trimester is a transient and functional hemodynamic phenomenon without apparent pathological significance, disappearing around 29 weeks gestation.
cross-section timing: Serial ultrasound examinations were performed at 20-23, 26-29, and 30-34 gestational weeks.
gest_age: Examinations were performed at 20-23, 26-29, and 30-34 gestational weeks.
